method: Require full clamped quadratic tensor definitions with degree-multiplicity internal knots. Pair the eight Bernstein cells by stored order and their own affine unit charts. Positive identical weights make paired image differences convex combinations of paired control differences. Exact binary-rational squared distances admit the full control nets; the existing continuous_bound tool independently reports outward-rounded bounds per cell. SDK spheres use exact center-distance plus radius-difference admission. No raw chart, pole or control geometry is changed.

command_image.chart_map: Pair the eight quadratic Bernstein cells in their stored u/v order; use the affine unit chart within each corresponding knot span. Knot multiplicities equal degree at every internal break.
